### 1) Visibility of the White Card **Yes.** The white-on-transparent route card is clearly visible in **both** themes. * In the **Light theme**, it sits inside a dark gray "stage" container, providing high contrast. * In the **Dark theme**, the stage background is slightly lighter than the main page background (or uses a subtle border), ensuring the card's boundaries and content remain distinct. ### 2) Text Contrast, Clipping, & Layout * **Contrast:** No issues. The card text (black on white/transparent) and the UI chrome text (dark gray/black in Light mode; white/light gray in Dark mode) meet accessibility standards. * **Clipping:** None observed. All buttons, labels, and statistics are fully rendered within their containers. * **Layout Breakage:** The layout is stable at 1440px. The two-column structure (Stage vs. Controls) maintains consistent alignment and spacing across both themes. ### 3) Dark Theme Chrome Readability **Excellent.** The dark theme handles the transition perfectly: * **Buttons:** The primary orange "Download PNG" button remains vibrant. The secondary "Repair" button switches to a clear outlined style with readable white text. * **Borders:** The stage panel and control cards use subtle light borders that define the areas without causing glare. * **Text:** Headings are pure white, while body text is a soft gray, creating a clear hierarchy that is easy on the eyes. ### 4) Overall Polish & Defects | Image | Score | Defects / Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Image 1 (Light)** | **9/10** | **Defects:**
• The tooltip/badge at the bottom of the stage ("Transparent background — shown on dark") has very low contrast (dark text on a dark black background).
• Minor: The "Local-first" badge in the header looks slightly "stuck" or lacks padding compared to the file name. | | **Image 2 (Dark)** | **9.5/10** | **Defects:**
• The same stage tooltip now has white text on a dark background, which is a significant improvement over Image 1, though it still blends slightly into the stage floor.
• Observation: The "N" icon in the bottom-left corner (likely a map attribution or dev tool) feels slightly orphaned outside the main layout grid. | **Summary:** This is a high-quality UI implementation. The "Share card" preview logic is robust, and the dark mode is not an afterthought—it feels native and polished. The only real "fail" point is the legibility of that specific bottom-center label in the Light theme.
